title: A Shocking Surprise
description: After Rey defeats Unkar's thugs, BB-8 spots Finn wearing Poe Dameron's jacket! Rey chases down Finn, knocking him to the ground. BB-8 waits for the right opportunity, shocking Finn with a surprising electric jolt! Finn explains how he obtained Poe's jacket escaping from The First Order and tells BB-8 he believes Poe did not survive their crash landing.
